versions.changelog: Redirect the first 60 tool-loop stop events with 换思路 and hard-stop the 61st; preserve gateway lifecycle state and support safe upgrades from v1.2.
Replace the 20-call hard stop with warnings at 20 and 40, raise the hard cap to 60, retain strict no-progress breakers, and support safe upgrades from v1.1.0.
Adds successful-but-no-progress detection for execute_code/terminal/process, a 20-call per-turn cap, lower circuit-breaker thresholds, and pytest-free deterministic installer verification.
Initial release: bounded promise-stop recovery, repeated-failure safeguards, polluted-session diagnostics, fail-closed compatibility checks, manifest backups, verification, and explicit rollback.
